description: The radius-two Vietoris–Rips complex of \([3]\times[3]\times[4]\) has a 96-dimensional third rational homology representation of \((S_3\wr S_2)\times S_4\) that is a sum of exactly fourteen pairwise nonisomorphic irreducibles, each once. Its full 45-class character is explicit, and the orbit-space quotient has vanishing positive-degree rational homology.
integrity: All mathematical claims supported by an embedded exhaustive standard-library verifier; exact finite computation and separate algebraic character argument.
scientific_limitations: Finite 36-vertex Rips complex at inclusive radius two; rational H3 under its natural order-1728 symmetry; no integral orbit-space torsion, larger-alphabet theorem, or independent external validation.
title: Multiplicity-free rational symmetry homology of the \(3\times3\times4\) Hamming Rips complex
